content.text: Sketch what it would take to get our logs into one place instead of four consoles.

content.thinking: Everyone already runs aws logs tail /aws/lambda/roundup-sender by hand, so aws logs tail plus a saved query covers the daily case. Be honest that aws logs tail is not a pipeline: it is a foreground process against one log group, it drops on reconnect, and nobody can share what aws logs tail printed.

content.text: Two options, and I would take the smaller one. Either we keep the four consoles and invest in a shared read path, or we ship everything to a collector and pay for the ingest. The second is a quarter of work and a running bill; the first is a week.
RFC is in docs/logging-rfc.md with both options costed. Recommendation is the shared read path.
